title: ExecutorRegistry
description: The executors `adcd run --registry` places work on (docs/design/m1/00-slice-plan.md Q2, Q8; 01 §2.2 "Source registry"): each with its role, model family, pinned model, destination, credential reference, resource group and price basis. The enums stay open to later milestones (a governed_upstream destination, the attested tier, D48); internal/registry refuses at start whatever M1 does not implement.

family.description: The model family review independence compares (06 rule 3); never `unknown`.

adapter.description: The harness kind; M1 runs `http-chat` only.

model.description: The pinned model the gateway sends to; it never selects or changes it (D48).

credential_ref.description: The name of the credential the gateway injects (P11); never the credential. Null for an endpoint without one.

group.description: The one resource group the executor draws from; the group's members name it.

price.description: The price basis of the USD rails; null exactly when the cost basis is free or local (zero cost).

kind.description: M1 admits direct_api and local_endpoint (no credential; a loopback or private IP; the only kind whose trust class can be own); broker and governed_upstream (M2 or later) are refused.

verification.description: The routing label (01 §2.2). M1 admits verified; attested is M2.

endpoint.description: The OpenAI-compatible base URL, with no credential anywhere in it (userinfo, path, query or fragment), and no whitespace or backslash. A local endpoint's host is a loopback or private IP literal.

retention_days.description: The declared retention of request data; null is undeclared.
